description: Show the curated public projects as a gallery of cards: name, category, stack, lifecycle, last-active date, test/CI signals, and the public repository link, with archive-wide totals. Hosts that support MCP Apps render it as an interactive gallery; others get the same data as JSON.

lifecycle.description: Only projects in this lifecycle, e.g. "active", "dormant" or "manual-only"; "none" for projects with no lifecycle

status.description: Only projects with this status, e.g. "active" or "stale"

name: show_project_gallery
title: Show project gallery
